objections.reason: "austeridade" is already the rendering of tapas (T122, dka' thub); duṣkaracaryā means hardship, so two different terms would share one rendering.
bhūmi 'ground' is rendered "estágio" in T155, while "terra" is the earth element there; "Terra" is inconsistent and ambiguous.
T155 children renders bodhisattva ground as "fase"; "Terra" is inconsistent and could be read as planet Earth by children.
